narrative.overview: The interface of someone who ships mission-critical fintech and stays calm. A deep near-black navy field where color lives in the content, not the chrome. Two rationed signals cut through: electric cyan for anything to act on, signal green for what is live and shipped. Depth comes from translucency and tonal layering, not decoration.
keyCharacteristics: Deep-navy control-room base; color lives in the content, not the chrome.
Two rationed accent signals: cyan = act, green = live/shipped.
Depth via translucency + tonal layering + soft glow, never heavy shadows or borders-as-decoration.
Pill-shaped tactile controls; large-radius (24px) glassy content cards.

rules.name: The Two-Signal Rule
rules.body: Cyan means act; green means live. No third accent hue, and neither signal is ever decoration.

rules.name: The One-Family Rule
rules.body: Inter carries the whole system; hierarchy is weight and size contrast, never a second typeface.

rules.name: The Glow-On-Demand Rule
rules.body: Rest is quiet; colored glow appears as a response to interactivity, never as ambient decoration.

dos: Do keep the navy control-room field dominant and let color live in the content.
Do ration the two signals: cyan for act, green for live/shipped only.
Do build type hierarchy from Inter weight/size contrast.
Do convey depth with translucency and one ambient shadow; add colored glow only on interaction.
Do verify body text hits 4.5:1 contrast.
Do ship both light and dark themes at parity.
donts: Don't introduce a third accent hue or spend cyan/green on decoration.
Don't use border-left/right greater than 1px as a colored stripe.
Don't stamp an icon tile or a tracked eyebrow above every heading.
Don't nest cards inside cards or use glassmorphism as decoration.
